info.name: Rosetta Platform Automated Test Suite (100 Assertions)
info.description: Comprehensive automated testing suite for Rosetta (Discord + Trello Hybrid Platform) covering Channels, Members, Messages, and Kanban Cards with 100 assertions.

exec: pm.test("01.1 - Status code is 200 OK", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("01.2 - Response latency is within SLA (< 1000ms)", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(1000); });
pm.test("01.3 - Content-Type is application/json", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('application/json'); });
pm.test("01.4 - Service status reports 'ok'", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.status).to.eql('ok'); });
pm.test("01.5 - Uptime seconds is a non-negative number", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.uptimeSeconds).to.be.a('number').and.to.be.at.least(0); });
pm.test("02.1 - Status code is 200 OK", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("02.2 - Total channels is a positive integer", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.totalChannels).to.be.a('number').and.to.be.above(0); });
pm.test("02.3 - Total members is a positive integer", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.totalMembers).to.be.a('number').and.to.be.above(0); });
pm.test("02.4 - Total messages is a valid number", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.totalMessages).to.be.a('number'); });
pm.test("02.5 - Total cards is a valid number", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.totalCards).to.be.a('number'); });
pm.test("03.1 - Status code is 200 OK", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("03.2 - Response is an array of channels", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d).to.be.an('array'); });

pm.test("03.3 - Contains default #general channel", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); const gen = d.find(c => c.name === 'general'); pm.expect(gen).to.not.be.undefined; pm.expect(gen.isDefault).to.be.true; });

pm.test("03.4 - Channel objects have valid schema", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d[0]).to.have.all.keys('id', 'name', 'description', 'category', 'isDefault', 'createdAt'); });
pm.test("03.5 - Latency is below 1000ms", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(1000); });
pm.test("04.1 - Status code is 200 OK", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("04.2 - Channel ID matches requested ID", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.id).to.eql('c-1'); });
pm.test("04.3 - Channel name is 'general'", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.name).to.eql('general'); });
pm.test("04.4 - Channel category is defined", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.category).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
pm.test("04.5 - Description is a non-empty string", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.description).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test("05.1 - Status code is 201 Created", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test("05.2 - Generated channel ID starts with 'c-'", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.id).to.match(/^c-/); });
pm.test("05.3 - Channel name is sanitized to lowercase", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.name).to.eql('qa-automation'); });
pm.test("05.4 - Newly created channel isDefault is false", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.isDefault).to.be.false; });

pm.test("05.5 - Set createdChannelId environment variable", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('createdChannelId', d.id); pm.expect(pm.environment.get('createdChannelId')).to.eql(d.id); });
pm.test("06.1 - Status code is 200 OK", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("06.2 - Updated description matches new value", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.description).to.eql('Updated description for QA Automation channel'); });
pm.test("06.3 - Channel ID is preserved", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.id).to.eql(pm.environment.get('createdChannelId')); });
pm.test("06.4 - Headers confirm application/json", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('application/json'); });
pm.test("06.5 - Response time under 1000ms", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(1000); });
pm.test("07.1 - Status code is 200 OK", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("07.2 - Members response is a non-empty array", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d).to.be.an('array').and.not.empty; });

pm.test("07.3 - Member objects contain id, name, username, and role", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d[0]).to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(d[0]).to.have.property('username'); pm.expect(d[0]).to.have.property('role'); });
pm.test("07.4 - Contains member with Admin role", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); const admin = d.find(m => m.role === 'Admin'); pm.expect(admin).to.not.be.undefined; });
pm.test("07.5 - Total member count is at least 4", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.length).to.be.at.least(4); });
pm.test("08.1 - Status code is 200 OK", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("08.2 - Member ID equals m-1", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.id).to.eql('m-1'); });
pm.test("08.3 - Member username is 'tanjim'", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.username).to.eql('tanjim'); });
pm.test("08.4 - Member role is 'Admin'", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.role).to.eql('Admin'); });
pm.test("08.5 - Member status is 'online'", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.status).to.eql('online'); });
pm.test("09.1 - Status code is 201 Created", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test("09.2 - Assigned member ID starts with 'm-'", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.id).to.match(/^m-/); });
pm.test("09.3 - Username is formatted in lowercase", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.username).to.eql('davidk'); });
pm.test("09.4 - Role matches assigned 'QA Engineer'", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.role).to.eql('QA Engineer'); });

pm.test("09.5 - Store createdMemberId in environment", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('createdMemberId', d.id); pm.expect(pm.environment.get('createdMemberId')).to.eql(d.id); });
pm.test("10.1 - Status code is 200 OK", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("10.2 - Member status updated to 'dnd'", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.status).to.eql('dnd'); });
pm.test("10.3 - Custom status message updated", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.customStatus).to.eql('Running Newman Tests in CI'); });
pm.test("10.4 - Response contains updated member ID", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.id).to.eql(pm.environment.get('createdMemberId')); });
pm.test("10.5 - Latency under 1000ms", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(1000); });
pm.test("11.1 - Status code is 200 OK", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("11.2 - Response is an array of messages", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test("11.3 - All messages belong to channel c-1", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); d.forEach(m => pm.expect(m.channelId).to.eql('c-1')); });
pm.test("11.4 - Messages have valid senderName and text", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d[0]).to.have.property('senderName'); pm.expect(d[0]).to.have.property('text'); });
pm.test("11.5 - Timestamp is a valid ISO format string", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(new Date(d[0].timestamp).toISOString()).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test("12.1 - Status code is 201 Created", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test("12.2 - Message ID starts with 'msg-'", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.id).to.match(/^msg-/); });
pm.test("12.3 - Message text matches submitted payload", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.text).to.eql('Automated QA message via Postman test script'); });
pm.test("12.4 - Sender name is populated from member data", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.senderName).to.eql('Tanjim Hossen'); });

pm.test("12.5 - Save createdMessageId to environment", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('createdMessageId', d.id); pm.expect(pm.environment.get('createdMessageId')).to.eql(d.id); });
pm.test("13.1 - Status code is 200 OK", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("13.2 - Message ID matches createdMessageId", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.id).to.eql(pm.environment.get('createdMessageId')); });
pm.test("13.3 - Text content is not empty", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.text).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
pm.test("13.4 - Associated channelId is c-1", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.channelId).to.eql('c-1'); });
pm.test("13.5 - Latency is under 1000ms", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(1000); });
pm.test("14.1 - Status code is 200 OK", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("14.2 - Confirmation message is returned", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.message).to.include('deleted successfully'); });
pm.test("14.3 - DeletedId matches targeted message", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.deletedId).to.eql(pm.environment.get('createdMessageId')); });
pm.test("14.4 - Content-Type is application/json", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('application/json'); });
pm.test("14.5 - Response time under 1000ms", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(1000); });
pm.test("15.1 - Status code is 200 OK", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("15.2 - Cards response is an array", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d).to.be.an('array'); });

pm.test("15.3 - Card objects have title, list, and priority", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d[0]).to.have.property('title'); pm.expect(d[0]).to.have.property('list'); pm.expect(d[0]).to.have.property('priority'); });

pm.test("15.4 - Card list matches valid Kanban column", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); const validLists = ['todo', 'in-progress', 'review', 'done']; pm.expect(validLists).to.include(d[0].list); });
pm.test("15.5 - Total cards count is at least 4", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.length).to.be.at.least(4); });
pm.test("16.1 - Status code is 201 Created", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test("16.2 - Card ID starts with 'card-'", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.id).to.match(/^card-/); });
pm.test("16.3 - Title matches submitted task", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.title).to.eql('Verify CI/CD Newman Test Execution'); });
pm.test("16.4 - Target column is 'todo' and priority is 'urgent'", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.list).to.eql('todo'); pm.expect(d.priority).to.eql('urgent'); });

pm.test("16.5 - Save createdCardId to environment", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('createdCardId', d.id); pm.expect(pm.environment.get('createdCardId')).to.eql(d.id); });

exec: pm.test("17.1 - Status code is 200 OK", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("17.2 - Card list column updated to 'in-progress'", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.list).to.eql('in-progress'); });

pm.test("17.3 - Card title and priority remain intact", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.title).to.eql('Verify CI/CD Newman Test Execution'); pm.expect(d.priority).to.eql('urgent'); });
pm.test("17.4 - Assignee name is correctly attached", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.assigneeName).to.eql('Tanjim Hossen'); });
pm.test("17.5 - Latency is under 1000ms", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(1000); });
pm.test("18.1 - Status code is 200 OK", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("18.2 - Filtered response is a non-empty array", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d).to.be.an('array').and.not.empty; });
pm.test("18.3 - Every returned card has list === 'in-progress'", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); d.forEach(c => pm.expect(c.list).to.eql('in-progress')); });

pm.test("18.4 - Response includes the recently moved card", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); const found = d.find(c => c.id === pm.environment.get('createdCardId')); pm.expect(found).to.not.be.undefined; });
pm.test("18.5 - Response time under 1000ms", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(1000); });
pm.test("19.1 - Status code is 200 OK", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("19.2 - Deletion message contains card title", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.message).to.include('deleted successfully'); });
pm.test("19.3 - DeletedId matches createdCardId", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.deletedId).to.eql(pm.environment.get('createdCardId')); });

pm.test("19.5 - Latency is below 1000ms", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(1000); });
pm.test("20.1 - Status code is 404 Not Found", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); });
